raw_text: KHALISTAN REFERENDUM 2024: Register now for the upcoming vote in Toronto, Vancouver, London, Melbourne. Every Sikh has the right to self-determination. The Indian government cannot silence our voice abroad. Mass mobilization underway — share with every Sikh family you know. Referendum dates and locations will be announced soon. Victory is inevitable.
clean_text: Khalistan Zindabad Official Telegram channel promoted SFJ referendum registration across diaspora cities including Toronto, Vancouver, London, and Melbourne, calling for mass mobilization.
